svg.aria-label: A universe in every layer. Seven concentric rings light from a violet core outward while a moon in the sky waxes from new to full. At full moon a Rinne Sharingan opens on it, a pupil inside three ripple rings carrying nine tomoe, and red light breaks across the sky. The rings are seven layers of work across sixteen repositories: learning core, data, models, applied AI, agents, knowledge and quantum.
svg.text: 7 LAYERS · 16 REPOSITORIES · ALL MINE, NO FORKS · BUILT OUTWARD FROM THE CORE
Foundations at the centre. Frontiers at the edge.
